first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current completion decline and has inherited evidence of durable activation and early-adoption gains. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, but its evidence is insufficiently explicit about retention, customer quality, and long-term revenue durability; verify it alongside the onboarding evidence before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its verified 18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12%, indicating poor renewal durability. Activation may also benefit from faster time-to-value, but that effect is not assumed as proven.
